interface_contract.TOPA: source digest and role provenance; authentic physical roles required for real data
interface_contract.EYE: preserve frequency and integration axes, clocks and uncertainty; no trajectory inference
interface_contract.RETINA: native score returned verbatim; no filtering or automatic veto
interface_contract.TACHYON: diagnostic score is not a carrier observation; require independent detection response and emission/receive pairing

thresholds.scope: historical synthetic operating point, shadow counters only; no tuning

frozen_exam.primary: Native functions must execute on all 288 newly generated, seed-disjoint compatible cubes; verify code and protocol blob hashes; direct-versus-adapter exact score parity on first cube per seed; input digest unchanged for every sample; fail closed for incompatible or unauthenticated roles; no mutation, no actual veto.
frozen_exam.secondary: Report per-seed and pooled AUC, weak retention, shadow losses vs frozen fixed comparator; do not treat new seeds from same generator as independent physical evidence.

requires: matched pointing and independent RFI control

rejections.reason: derived DM catalog, no compatible four-role spectrogram cube; cannot make up OFF/repeat data

limits: No claim of real telescope data or independent blind test; generator is same native generator but new seeds.
